observations.statement: Every response of GET /api/merchant/campaigns/{id}.json with status 200 carried cache-control "private, max-age=14400"; expires "-1"; no etag.

The first request for a never-used v value always returned cf-cache-status MISS with last-modified equal to the response date, and the body reflected the current saved state (artwork current_version_id of the latest PUT /api/artworks, config value of the latest PUT /api/instances/609/config).

Repeat requests for an already-filled URL returned HIT with the same body hash and unchanged last-modified; age counts from the first fill. v=1, no v, and v=1789525723 are separate cache entries (each had its own first MISS at 15:41:17-18Z).

After Save on the portal (PUT /api/artworks/{id}, PUT /api/instances/609/config), the three URL forms the storefront/SDK can use (v=1789525723 = Liquid window.teeinblueCampaign.version, v=1, no v) kept serving the pre-Save body: at T0 (age 94), ~T+2 min (age 213), ~T+5 min (age 393/459), after Part B (age 1125), and on 2026-11-01 (age 61779 at 08:50:58Z for v=1/no v; age 65406/65507 at 09:50:42Z/09:52:23Z for v=1789525723 on the buyer tab).

Observed age exceeded the declared max-age=14400 while still HIT: 61779 s (v=1 and no v, filled 2026-10-31T15:41:18-19Z, read 2026-11-01T08:50:58Z) and 65406/65507 s (v=1789525723 buyer-path entry, read 2026-11-01T09:50:42Z/09:52:23Z). No revalidation/refresh at ~19:41Z was observed.

Two cached copies of the same URL v=1789525723 coexisted: script/curl clients saw last-modified 'Sat, 31 Oct 2026 15:41:19 GMT' (fill 15:41:18Z by a script MISS), while browser clients (headless Chromium on 2026-10-31 and the Playwright MCP buyer tab on 2026-11-01) saw last-modified 'Sat, 31 Oct 2026 15:43:57 GMT' with age counting from 2026-10-31T15:40:36Z (= the browser MISS at 15:40:35.967Z). The script GET at 15:41:18Z was MISS although a browser had filled the same URL 43 s earlier.

Storefront page HTML carries window.teeinblueCampaign.version = 1789525723 and a preload link with the same v; it did not change after artwork Save or config Save (all storefront loads 2026-10-31 15:40Z..15:50Z and 2026-11-01 09:50Z..09:57Z). Campaign #2605 need_sync stayed false after artwork Saves (2 checks).
Platform-product SDK JSON 404 responses carried cache-control "private, max-age=86400" (cf MISS).

SDK script app-v2.js: the buyer tab's first load ran a browser-HTTP-cached copy (last-modified Tue, 15 Sep 2026 05:06:17 GMT, cache-control max-age=315360000, length 1646222); the server copy at 09:52Z had last-modified Sat, 31 Oct 2026 06:27:32 GMT, cache-control max-age=14400 (cf REVALIDATED after fetch cache:'reload').

Product Page Settings Save (PUT /api/instances/609/config) persisted 16 config keys that were absent before; the revert (ACT-02-01-005) restored show_navigation_numbers only, so instance 609 config is not data-equal to its pre-run state (SDK JSON config 155 -> 171 keys, values of the old keys unchanged).
SDK campaign JSON on staging-api is served to anonymous clients (no cookie, no storefront password) for a password-protected dev store.

assumptions: Page-list rows in a capture whose page idx precede the action (ACT-02-01-005 bootstrap rows) belong to an earlier navigation; attribution by idx order, not by timestamp.
unknowns: 39 POST /api/graphql rows have no operationName/body in capture; cannot be attributed (labelled unknown).
Cause of CF cache partition per client type for v=1789525723 (CACHE-06) and of HIT with age > max-age (CACHE-05).
Whether campaign Update/Sync changes window.teeinblueCampaign.version (not observed; forbidden).
Whether the 16 newly persisted config keys change storefront behaviour vs previous SDK defaults.
Auth/request headers of portal and storefront requests (not exported).

observations.fact: Every response of GET /api/merchant/campaigns/{id}.json with status 200 carried cache-control "private, max-age=14400"; expires "-1"; no etag.
observations.note: 'private' is declared, yet Cloudflare returned cf-cache-status HIT to separate clients (see CACHE-03/04). Cause (CF cache rule overriding origin header?) not observed.

observations.fact: The first request for a never-used v value always returned cf-cache-status MISS with last-modified equal to the response date, and the body reflected the current saved state (artwork current_version_id of the latest PUT /api/artworks, config value of the latest PUT /api/instances/609/config).
observations.timing: Earliest fresh-v read after a Save: 41 s after PUT /api/artworks/4167 (15:42:47Z -> 15:43:28Z, new text present); ~2-12 s after PUT /api/instances/609/config (15:50:0xZ -> 15:50:12Z, show_navigation_numbers true). No lower bound measured.

observations.fact: Repeat requests for an already-filled URL returned HIT with the same body hash and unchanged last-modified; age counts from the first fill. v=1, no v, and v=1789525723 are separate cache entries (each had its own first MISS at 15:41:17-18Z).

After Save on the portal (PUT /api/artworks/{id}, PUT /api/instances/609/config), the three URL forms the storefront/SDK can use (v=1789525723 = Liquid window.teeinblueCampaign.version, v=1, no v) kept serving the pre-Save body: at T0 (age 94), ~T+2 min (age 213), ~T+5 min (age 393/459), after Part B (age 1125), and on 2026-11-01 (age 61779 at 08:50:58Z for v=1/no v; age 65406/65507 at 09:50:42Z/09:52:23Z for v=1789525723 on the buyer tab).

Observed age exceeded the declared max-age=14400 while still HIT: 61779 s (v=1 and no v, filled 2026-10-31T15:41:18-19Z, read 2026-11-01T08:50:58Z) and 65406/65507 s (v=1789525723 buyer-path entry, read 2026-11-01T09:50:42Z/09:52:23Z). No revalidation/refresh at ~19:41Z was observed.
observations.note: 3 HIT samples beyond max-age, two URL variants, single edge (all requests appear to hit the same POP; other POPs not observed). Whether CF edge TTL is configured independently of the origin header is unknown.

observations.fact: Two cached copies of the same URL v=1789525723 coexisted: script/curl clients saw last-modified 'Sat, 31 Oct 2026 15:41:19 GMT' (fill 15:41:18Z by a script MISS), while browser clients (headless Chromium on 2026-10-31 and the Playwright MCP buyer tab on 2026-11-01) saw last-modified 'Sat, 31 Oct 2026 15:43:57 GMT' with age counting from 2026-10-31T15:40:36Z (= the browser MISS at 15:40:35.967Z). The script GET at 15:41:18Z was MISS although a browser had filled the same URL 43 s earlier.
observations.unknown: Why the cache is partitioned per client type (request-header Vary? different POP?) and why the browser copy's last-modified (15:43:57) differs from its age-derived fill time (15:40:36). The browser load at 15:43:57Z reported HIT without an age header and last-modified equal to the request time, body hash still the pre-Save one (3fefc7058658). Not interpreted.

observations.fact: Storefront page HTML carries window.teeinblueCampaign.version = 1789525723 and a preload link with the same v; it did not change after artwork Save or config Save (all storefront loads 2026-10-31 15:40Z..15:50Z and 2026-11-01 09:50Z..09:57Z). Campaign #2605 need_sync stayed false after artwork Saves (2 checks).
observations.note: Whether campaign Update/Sync bumps the version was not observed (publish_live forbidden).

observations.fact: Platform-product SDK JSON 404 responses carried cache-control "private, max-age=86400" (cf MISS).

SDK script app-v2.js: the buyer tab's first load ran a browser-HTTP-cached copy (last-modified Tue, 15 Sep 2026 05:06:17 GMT, cache-control max-age=315360000, length 1646222); the server copy at 09:52Z had last-modified Sat, 31 Oct 2026 06:27:32 GMT, cache-control max-age=14400 (cf REVALIDATED after fetch cache:'reload').
observations.note: Implication: a buyer browser that cached the script under the old 10-year max-age may keep running an old SDK build; only one browser observed.
